name: Abracadabra Spell
rootCause: On-chain black magic led to two of Abracadabra’s cauldrons springing a leak yesterday. $6.5M gone and MIM losing its magic... What dark arts are needed for a full repeg?

descriptions.text: On-chain black magic led to two of Abracadabra’s cauldrons springing a leak yesterday. $6.5M gone and MIM losing its magic... What dark arts are needed for a full repeg?

The DeFi protocol Abracadabra Money (MIM_Spell) has fallen victim to an attack, resulting in approximately $6.5 million in losses. Following the attack, Abracadabra.Money (MIM_Spell) provided an update on the situation via Twitter, stating that their technical team identified the vulnerability. Preliminary findings indicate the exploit targeted specific Cauldrons V3 & V4, allowing unauthorized MIM borrowing. They’ve mitigated the issue by setting borrowing limits to zero for these cauldrons.

On January 30, 2024, Abracadabra Money's Cauldron V4 contracts on Ethereum Mainnet were exploited via a rounding-error bug in debt accounting. The attacker manipulated debt share calculations, draining over $6.5M in MIM and ETH by enabling unbacked borrowing. The protocol’s stablecoin MIM temporarily lost its peg, prompting mitigation by the DAO. A rounding error in Cauldron V4's debt-share and total debt accounting allowed a mismatch between 'base' (borrow shares) and 'elastic' (real asset debt). This enabled solvency checks to pass even for uncollateralized borrows, facilitating extraction of unbacked assets.
